subject.title: refactor: separate external conversations from local sessions

question: Should OpenClaw adopt these conversation tools, Gateway/plugin API contracts, and agent-database v11 model as the permanent boundary between external transport addresses and local model sessions?
rationale: This creates public tools and protocol methods, expands plugin-facing delivery contracts, and advances the persistent agent SQLite schema; root policy requires explicit maintainer acceptance of the product and migration direction.

options.title: Approve after blockers
options.body: Adopt the architecture after cancellation is authoritative and live Reef, restart, and v10-upgrade proof is attached to the exact head.

options.title: Split the contract
options.body: Approve the session/conversation distinction but separate public API, durable delivery, Reef integration, and schema migration into smaller dependent PRs.

options.title: Pause the direction
options.body: Do not merge the new permanent API and state model until a narrower contract or different ownership boundary is chosen.

recommendation.title: Approve after blockers
recommendation.body: Adopt the architecture after cancellation is authoritative and live Reef, restart, and v10-upgrade proof is attached to the exact head.

likelyOwner.reason: They proposed the linked feature, own the branch, are assigned, and carry the central session, Gateway, database, and Reef changes.
